COMMON ORDER Writ Petitions in W.P.Nos.9668, 9710, 9750 and 11190 of 2023 have been filed to quash the impugned notification dated 13.03.2023 vide No.02/MRB/2021 issued by the Medical Services Recruitment Board, wherein the petitioners names are withheld for the purpose of production of equivalence certificate and consequently direct the respondents to include the petitioners names in the selection list for the post of Food Safety Officer for the Recruitment Year 2021.
2.

W.P.Nos.9705 and 11187 of 2023 have been filed to declare the degree of B.Tech in Food Processing Engineering possessed by the petitioners is deemed to equal to the degree of B.Tech in Food Technology as per the proceedings reference No.E.1/AC/135/V.1/2018 dated 27.02.2018 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.9668, 9705, 9710, 9750, 11187, 11190,19028 and 23768 of 2023 and W.M.P.Nos. 9720, 9722, 9723, 9772, 9773, 9834, 9836, 9837, 9840, 11061, 11062 and 23285 of 2023 issued by the Tamilnadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore, and include the Petitioners' names in the Selection List, as the petitioners names are withheld for the purpose of production of equivalence certificate.

3. W.P.Nos.19028 and 23768 of 2023 have been filed to issue direction to the respondents to issue Formal Appointment Orders to the Petitioners who were declared as newly selected Food Safety Officers as they were already selected, sent for training and on successful completion of the same they are waiting for the Appointment Orders.
4.

Since all the above petitions are filed seeking certain reliefs against the impugned order of the Medical Services Recruitment Board dated 13.03.2023, they are all disposed of by way of this Common Order.
5. The Petitioners have applied for the post of Food Safety Officer vide Notification No.02/MRB/2021 dated 13.10.2021.

Education qualification for the post is as follows:

9834, 9836, 9837, 9840, 11061, 11062 and 23285 of 2023 6B.
EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION:

Candidates should possess the following or its equivalent qualification for the post of Food Safety Officer on the date of this notification (13.10.2021) i. A Bachelor's degree in Food Technology or Dairy Technology or Biotechnology or Oil Technology or Agricultural Science or veterinary Sciences or Bio- Chemistry or Microbiology or G. 6. The petitioners though provisionally selected, the selection has been withheld for the production of Equivalence Certificate.

It is relevant to note that the Government has passed G.O.(Ms) No.93 Higher Education (K2) Department dated 30.05.2019 and constituted a New Equivalence https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.9668, 9705, 9710, 9750, 11187, 11190,19028 and 23768 of 2023 and W.M.P.Nos. 9720, 9722, 9723, 9772, 9773, 9834, 9836, 9837, 9840, 11061, 11062 and 23285 of 2023 Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to Government, Higher Education Department with nine (9) members to examine the request of the educational institutions to issue equivalence to the courses offered by them.

In the said G.O., the Government also directed the general public / students / teachers / colleges / Universities / Recruitment boards / other stakeholders who seek equivalence of the courses offered by the Colleges / Universities to address the Tamil Nadu State council for Higher Education, directly.

7. Though this Government Order has been passed in the year 2018 much prior to the notification referred above, it is relevant to note that as far as the equivalence degree in respect of appointment of Food Safety Officers, the notification clearly stipulates that equivalence should be recognised or notified by the Central Government.

Therefore, in view of the above specific direction contained in the notification that equivalence should be recognised/notified by the Central Government, the State Government now cannot contend that as per G.O.(Ms) No.93 No.93 Higher Education (K2)
D e p a r t m e n t d a t e d 3 0 . 0 5 . 2 0 1 9 , t h e c a n d i d a t e s o u g h t t o h a v e a p p l i e d t o t h e https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.9668, 9705, 9710, 9750, 11187, 11190,19028 and 23768 of 2023 and W.M.P.Nos. 9720, 9722, 9723, 9772, 9773, 9834, 9836, 9837, 9840, 11061, 11062 and 23285 of 2023 Tamil Nadu State Council for Higher Eudcation directly with regard to equivalence.
Even any application received by the Government, the Government could not have been in a position to notify the equivalence or recognised qualification as mandated in the notification since it is only by the Central Government such notification is required as per the above notification.
8.
It is not disputed that the petitioners are provisionally selected.
The results are withheld only due to non-production of equivalence certificate.
It is relevant to note that equivalence certificate cannot be produced by the candidates as required by the notification then and there.
It is for the concerned Government to constitute the committee every year to assess the equivalent degree.
The notification also does not specify that the equivalence certificate should have been issued prior to the notification.
Whereas it stipulates only the degree or any other equivalent /recognised qualification notified by the Central Government.

Taking note of the above, this Court, on the submissions of the learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the MSRB, passed an order on 03.04.2023 wherein it is the stand of MSRB G.
